messages:
deploybot: Deploy pipeline started for release v2.3.1 (tag: v2.3.1, commit: 9f4b2d3). env: staging. Change window: daily 02:00-04:00 UTC. Pipeline: build → lint → unit → integration. Link: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/2301234567

sara: saw this, will monitor. tagging @josh for infra changes in the build.

josh: noted. I'm on call for infra today.

deploybot: Lint step failed on staging build (9f4b2d3). Error: `eslint: no-undef` in src/runtime/serve.ts:112. Logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/2301234567/logs

priya: hmm, that's the new helper I added. I ran lint locally but missed an eslint config change. I'll open a PR now.

sara: given change window closes in ~90m, are we pinning older runtime to avoid blocking release? @release-coordinator-bot what's the rollback policy?

release-coordinator-bot: Reminder: For patch releases in the daily window, prefer quick patch PRs over rollbacks unless >30m to fix. If patch not ready within 30m, escalate to rollback.

amanda: can we hotfix by reverting that commit? That'd be faster.

priya: I can revert the helper change in a tiny PR, run CI, and push. Should be under 20m.

josh: agree with revert. If you need me to approve I can prioritize.

sara: ok let's proceed with revert PR and re-run pipeline. @deploybot please cancel current build and trigger new build on commit 1a2b3c4 (revert PR merge) when available.

deploybot: Build canceled for 9f4b2d3 by @sara. Observability: previous runs cached artifacts will be invalidated.

priya: opened PR #4567: revert 'use-new-helpers' -> target main. CI will run.

deploybot: PR merged: main @ commit 1a2b3c4 (merge PR #4567). Triggering pipeline for tag v2.3.1-staging (commit 1a2b3c4).

deploybot: Pipeline progress: build ✅, lint ✅, unit ✅, integration ⏳ (running).

sara: good. Plan to proceed with canary after integration passes.

deploybot: Pipeline finished: all checks passed for commit 1a2b3c4. Staging deploy scheduled at 2023-08-01T02:30:00Z (within change window). Release notes: 'patch: revert helper change to satisfy lint; no behavior changes.'

josh: rolling canary at 02:30, monitoring latency/health.

priya: thanks everyone. Will watch post-deploy for errors and follow up if anything pops.

amanda: adding note to release tracker: /releases/v2.3.1 - lint revert (PR #4567).
